articles.title: Local Business Owners Celebrate New Business Venture with Opening of PostalAnnex Location in Mint Hill, North Carolina
articles.mainIdea: Local Business Owners Celebrate New Business Venture with Opening of PostalAnnex Location in Mint Hill, North Carolina
articles.summary: PR Newswire: Local Business Owners Celebrate New Business Venture with Opening of PostalAnnex Location in Mint Hill, North Carolina. Annex Brands, Inc., one of the leading franchisors in the packing, shipping, and office services industries, is proud to announce the opening of its newest PostalAnnex location in Mint Hill, NC by new owners, Sonal and Jyotsna Parmar. This new PostalAnnex is set to offer a wide range of essential shipping services, mailbox rentals, and office services to the local community. Related tickers mentioned: UPS.

articles.title: New Ownership of 36-Year-Old AIM Mail Center in Rancho Santa Margarita, CA Set to Offer Extended Hours and Expanded Office Services
articles.mainIdea: New Ownership of 36-Year-Old AIM Mail Center in Rancho Santa Margarita, CA Set to Offer Extended Hours and Expanded Office Services
articles.summary: PR Newswire: New Ownership of 36-Year-Old AIM Mail Center in Rancho Santa Margarita, CA Set to Offer Extended Hours and Expanded Office Services. Annex Brands, Inc., a leading franchisor in the packing, shipping, and office services industries, is pleased to announce the successful transfer of ownership of an existing AIM Mail Center location in Rancho Santa Margarita, CA to new owner, Venus Qurbanzadeh. This transition to new ownership ensures that the community will continue to benefit from the essential shipping and office services provided by this AIM Mail Center for the last 36 years. Related tickers mentioned: DHLGY, UPS.
